description: This file defines the AccountAssociationsData class, which models the association between accounts in the Fineract financial platform. It contains references to account data objects and provides a constructor and accessor method.

classes.name: AccountAssociationsData
classes.description: A data class representing associations between accounts, including an identifier, an account, and a linked account.

methods.name: AccountAssociationsData
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the AccountAssociationsData with an ID, an account, and a linked account.

methods.name: linkedAccount
methods.description: Accessor method to retrieve the linked account associated with this data object.
